vocab.zh: 主动的；积极预先行动的
vocab.simpleEn: taking action before a problem gets worse
vocab.simpleZh: 问题变严重前主动处理。
vocab.exampleEn: I try to be proactive by reviewing my mistakes after every practice session.
vocab.exampleZh: 我会主动复盘每次练习后的错误。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use proactive when describing a good habit or work style.
vocab.upgradeZh: 描述好习惯或工作方式时，可以用 proactive。
